sources.quote: 7.1.5.3.2 Verification of a special characteristic by an external laboratory needs prior notification to Stellantis and acceptance of the laboratory scope.
8.3.3.3 Any change to a characteristic designated special, to its control method or to its sampling frequency needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
Note: Tensile tests are performed in the Plant 1 internal materials laboratory.
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.

findings.why: BR-220 is on program STL-Torino-27 (Annex A of the Stellantis CSR). Line 30 of the control plan verifies SC-01 with a tensile test in the internal Plant 1 lab. Moving that test to the external Laboratorio Sigma needs prior notification to Stellantis and acceptance of the lab scope. It also changes the control method of a special characteristic, which needs written approval. No notification or approval is in the documents.
